decision_conditions: All tree works will be carried out in accordance with British Standard 3998: 2010 Tree work. Recommendations. In order to carry out the tree works to BS 3998:2010 there will be only the removal of secondary and tertiary branches, no primary branches. All finalpruning cuts on the branches will not exceed a third of the diameter of the main stem of the tree when measured at 1.5 meters above ground level. Reason: To ensure that the works are carried out in accordance with good arboricultural practice.

This decision notice for Tree Works is only valid for 2 years from the date of this decision or until the work is completed, whichever is the sooner. Reason: In order to ensure that the work is carried out whilst still appropriate and in accordance with the time period within the legislation and regulations.

Insufficient evidence has been provided to justify the removal of both the Sycamore and Oak on safety grounds. Seasonal nuisance associated with leaf and seed fall and pollen is an accepted cyclical occurrence of trees and does not have sufficient weight to  justify the removal of trees that are considered to be important to the character and appearance of the area. Concerns regarding structural damage to the property are unfounded as the property is positioned on a chalk subsoil. Lesser works have granted to enable pruning to help manage the relationship of the tree to the dwelling
